Recommendation: V4 Two-tone

It fits the most on screen: 30 items at 390 with Brands open and 14 on a small 320 phone, against 27 and 11 today. The five quick chips put Super Sale and Under 54 AED one tap away before she scrolls, and the list underneath keeps today's look, so it is the smallest change for shoppers who already know the menu. If you want the boldest look instead, V6 Blush is the one: the Super Sale ribbon and chip-style brands stand out most, and it still shows more than today.

Every style keeps the same items, the same two columns, search, one-section-at-a-time, swipe to close and the left glass panel (right in Arabic). All sizing is CSS (clamp and container units); nothing measures the screen in script and no font or image is added. V3 also needs its 15 small icons in the page once (about 1 KB gzipped). Nothing ships until you pick a letter.
